title: AiMemoryItem
description: ai.memory-item@1 (OpenVibe.AI; Memory M2): one memory item as the person's own API reads it. Tenant is the owner (`user:usr_…`); the text is decrypted only inside AI's process and never logged, never in an error, a span or an event. `source_ref` is the file path relative to the scanned root and the heading, when the item came from a file.

scope.description: `user` for the person's own notes, or `project:<slug>` for a repo or folder they chose. Never an absolute path.

text.description: The item text after the server-side redaction. Only the person's own routes and a granted agent search see it.

source.description: The adapter id (claude-code, cursor, …) or the service (actor, vibe, know, person).

source_ref.description: The path relative to the scanned root and the heading, when the item came from a file.

machine.description: The Node machine id it came from, when it came from one.

no_looks.description: True when the item was produced by an AI: the server ran noLooks on it (Memory M2 rule 5).
